scope.description: Versioned source inventory, separate from implementation and verification results. It indexes every Markdown page in the pinned chialisp-web docs directory and every entry in the pinned CHIP index; it does not yet enumerate every example or follow every reference implementation.
scope.migration_claim: No tutorial or CHIP is marked migrated merely because a smaller original regression fixture exercises the same concept.
scope.promotion_requirement: A status beyond not_run requires linked local source and a reproducible evidence report; retain unsupported cases and hash-identity obligations explicitly.

entries.title: Conditions
entries.security_note: Prefer SEND_MESSAGE/RECEIVE_MESSAGE in new compositions; retain announcements only where required by existing protocols.

entries.title: Singletons
entries.migration_notes: The canonical singleton launcher and pay-to-singleton announcement component have separate finite Cargo/native/Chialisp/Rue and simulator evidence in corpus/validation.json (puzzles singleton-launcher and p2-singleton). The canonical singleton top layer is a host counterpart, not a Rust port. This does not validate this complete page, the whole singleton protocol, or its older linked revisions.
